SETTINGS.ERR_API_KEY: The API key seems to be invalid.
SETTINGS.ERR_DNSMASQ_PLUGIN: It seems that the DNSMasq Plugin is installed. Please read the documentation!
SETTINGS.ERR_FOSHKSERVER: Enter a valid hostname or ip address
SETTINGS.ERR_NO_WEATHERSTATION: Could not find a weatherstation with that name.
SETTINGS.HINT_APIKEY: Only letters and numbers without special characters are allowed in the API key.
SETTINGS.HINT_CLOUDEMU: Start the Weatherserver Emulator. Please read documentation for details!
SETTINGS.HINT_CONFIGUREWEATHERSERVICE: Please configure the chosen weather service below.
SETTINGS.HINT_FETCHOK: Data fetched successfully. Check logfile for details.
SETTINGS.HINT_FORECAST: Please choose only the forecasts you really would like to use. This will reduce the load on your miniserver.
SETTINGS.HINT_FOSHKGRABBER: Grab current data from the FOSHKplugin and use it instead of weatherservice data. Enter the host or ip address of the FOSHKplugin LoxBerry. Use 'localhost' if the plugin runs on this LoxBerry. Default Port is 8080.
SETTINGS.HINT_FREE_ACCOUNT: Please check your API licence and our Wiki how many (free) calls are available!
SETTINGS.HINT_HTML: Get data by a Virtual HTML Input
SETTINGS.HINT_JUSTFORWEBPAGE: This is just used on the weather webpage. Choose whatever you want here.
SETTINGS.HINT_LATITUDE: Please enter a valid latitude between -90 and 90 degrees.
SETTINGS.HINT_LONGITUDE: Please enter a valid longitude between -180 and 180 degrees.
SETTINGS.HINT_LOXGRABBER: Grab current local data from Miniserver and use it instead of weatherservice data.
SETTINGS.HINT_MASKKEYS: Mask all API keys in the logs to prevent misuse if you share the logs. Logs help us reproduce and understand your issues, but we don't want your keys to fall into the wrong hands!
SETTINGS.HINT_MINISERVER: Use this Miniserver with the plugin.
SETTINGS.HINT_MQTTTOPIC: Data is automatically send to MQTT (if MQTT is in LoxBerry configured). The data is published under this topic.
SETTINGS.HINT_OPENMETEOAIRQUALITYGRABBER: Fetches current data from Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com) for air quality and pollen forecast. Free of charge, no API key required. Enter coordinates (Lat/Lon).
SETTINGS.HINT_PWSCATCHUPLOADGRABBER: Grab current data from the WU Upload Catcher plugin and use it instead of weatherservice data. The plugin must be installed on this LoxBerry.
SETTINGS.HINT_SENDWHAT: Current weather data is always send. But to reduce load at your Miniserver, forecast data is only send if it is selected here (not needed for the weather emulator!).
SETTINGS.HINT_STATIONID: Only letters and numbers without special characters are allowed in the Station ID.
SETTINGS.HINT_UDP: Send data by UDP to Miniserver
SETTINGS.HINT_UDPPORT: Please enter a valid port between 1 and 65000
SETTINGS.HINT_USEALTERNATEDFC: Use an alternative weather service for daily forecast data.
SETTINGS.HINT_USEALTERNATEHFC: Use an alternative weather service for hourly forecast data.
SETTINGS.HINT_WEATHERFLOWSTATIONID: Your Station ID, from which you would like to grab current weather data and forcasts.
SETTINGS.HINT_WETTERONLINESTATIONID: Enter the location slug from the WetterOnline URL (e.g. 'dresden' or 'berlin'). Find it by searching your city on wetteronline.de and copying the last part of the URL, e.g. https://www.wetteronline.de/wetter/dresden. Multi-word names are hyphenated, e.g. 'frankfurt-am-main'. German umlauts are replaced (ae, oe, ue).
SETTINGS.HINT_WTTRINSTATIONID: You can enter a city name, a point of interest, an IATA airport code or GPS coordinates (like 51.07,13.77) here.
SETTINGS.HINT_WUGRABBER: Grab current station data from Wunderground® and use it instead of weather service data.
